title: rosa canina subvar. schlimpertii
intro: Rosa canina subvar. schlimpertii, commonly known as Dwarf Dog Rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant, a type of wild rose native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and constipation, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Dog Rose are attributed to its ability to modulate the gastrointestinal system, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
